annotation.title_clean: Statement by the Privacy Commissioner of Canada regarding a joint investigation of OpenAI’s ChatGPT
annotation.title_en: Statement by the Privacy Commissioner of Canada regarding a joint investigation of OpenAI’s ChatGPT
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Office of the Privacy Commissioner of Canada
annotation.venue: Office of the Privacy Commissioner of Canada website
annotation.summary_en: Statement by Canada's Privacy Commissioner announcing findings of a joint federal-provincial investigation into OpenAI's ChatGPT. Training data collection was overly broad and lacked consent and transparency; OpenAI agreed to remedies, and the complaint was found well founded and conditionally resolved. Calls for modernised privacy laws.
key_provisions_or_claims: Joint investigation by federal, Quebec, BC and Alberta privacy regulators found ChatGPT's initial training breached Canadian privacy law.
Concerns: overly broad collection, consent and transparency, inaccuracy, access/correction/deletion, accountability.
OpenAI agreed to limit personal data used for training; complaint conditionally resolved under PIPEDA.
Calls for modernising Canada's privacy laws for AI.
